command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP baseline"
rpm -q tree 2>&1 || true
dnf -q repolist enabled

echo "STEP install createrepo_c and download package+deps while network still up"
dnf install -y createrepo_c
mkdir -p /srv/localrepo
dnf install -y --downloadonly --destdir=/srv/localrepo tree
ls -la /srv/localrepo

echo "STEP build repo metadata"
createrepo_c /srv/localrepo
ls /srv/localrepo/repodata | head

echo "STEP write local repo definition"
cat > /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo <<EOF
[local-repo]
name=Local package repository (node1 local storage)
baseurl=http://$NODE_IP:8080/
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-redhat-release
EOF
cat /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo

echo "STEP start http server serving local repo from local storage"
pkill -f "http.server 8080" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
cd /srv/localrepo
nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind "$NODE_IP" > /var/log/local-repo-httpd.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /var/run/local-repo-httpd.pid
sleep 2
cat /var/run/local-repo-httpd.pid
ss -tlnp | grep 8080 || true

echo "STEP open firewall port for local repo"
firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp --permanent
firewall-cmd --reload
firewall-cmd --list-ports

echo "STEP verify local repo is servable"
curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "local repo http_code=%{http_code}\n" "http://$NODE_IP:8080/repodata/repomd.xml"

echo "STEP make usual remote repositories unreachable"
dnf config-manager --disable rhel-10-for-x86_64-appstream-rpms rhel-10-for-x86_64-baseos-rpms
cp /etc/hosts /etc/hosts.bak
echo "127.0.0.1 cdn.redhat.com" >> /etc/hosts
dnf -q repolist enabled

echo "STEP prove remote is unreachable"
curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "cdn.redhat.com http_code=%{http_code}\n" https://cdn.redhat.com/ 2>&1 || echo "cdn.redhat.com curl FAILED as expected"
dnf --disablerepo="*" --enablerepo="rhel-10-for-x86_64-appstream-rpms" makecache 2>&1 | tail -5 || echo "remote repo makecache FAILED as expected"

echo "STEP install package from local repo only while remote unreachable"
dnf install -y --disablerepo="*" --enablerepo="local-repo" tree
echo "STEP verify install"
rpm -q tree
rpm -qi tree | grep -E "Name|Version|Vendor|Signature"
dnf -q repoquery -q --installed --qf "%{name} %{reponame}" tree
echo "DONE"
